fork.note: LOCAL-FIXTURE ONLY (scripts/official/empty_rpc.py, empty state) — NOT a mainnet-fork replay. block_number is a non-zero placeholder required by the runner. The incident spanned multiple chains (most losses on Arbitrum); the fixture uses a representative source->dest pair.

contracts.note: Minimal reconstruction in official/; no production addresses asserted.

root_cause_summary.vulnerable_pattern: ReceiverAxelar.expressExecute executed a relayed payload without calling the Axelar gateway's validateContractCall, so a fabricated command/payload made PortalV2 release unbacked tokens.
root_cause_summary.verification_bypass: The express path skipped the gateway attestation entirely; its only guard was a peer check on attacker-controlled sourceChain/sourceAddress, which provided no real security.
root_cause_summary.fix: Require gateway.validateContractCall(commandId) on the express path as the normal path already does.

exploit_characteristics.style: forged Axelar message executed via unvalidated express path -> unbacked PortalV2 release
exploit_characteristics.notes: Loss reported ~$1.4M (QuillAudits, Olympix) to ~$2.8M-$3M (BlockSec and others); dates range 2026-01-31 to 2026-02-02 across sources. Recorded as a range lower bound.
